buckets.label: Secondary-language requirement
buckets.note: At least one course in a secondary language or literature (taught in a language other than English). May overlap with other requirements. Confirmed from catalog.ucsd.edu/curric/LIT-ug.html. Department-wide secondary-language requirement: complete the lower-division sequence in a second language through its designated terminal course. This is a proficiency-style requirement (not a fixed single course set) — it can be satisfied by any of several language sequences OR by an upper-division literature course taught in a language other than English. Terminal lower-division courses by language: French LTFR 2C; German LTGM 2C; Italian LTIT 50; Korean LTKO 2C; Russian LTRU 2B; Classical Greek LTGK 3; Latin LTLA 3; Spanish LTSP 2C/2E/3F. Hebrew is JUDA 3 and ASL 1E (subject codes JUDA/ASL not in the Literature ranges; not listed in courses[]). For the Literary Arts major specifically the catalog phrases it as 'at least one course in a secondary language or literature; that is, a course taught in a language other than English,' so it may also be met via an upper-div LTFR/LTSP/LTGM/etc. course taught in the target language.
